name: FAIR Universe HiggsML Uncertainty Challenge
description: The task involves estimating the signal strength parameter (µ) for Higgs boson events relative to the Standard Model prediction, along with a 68.27% Confidence Interval (CI), accounting for systematic uncertainties and distribution shifts.

cr:input.name: input_data
cr:input.description: Input dataset containing columns 'id' and 'mu16'. 'id' represents sample identifiers, and 'mu16' represents the lower bound of the signal strength parameter µ. Example: 'id' = sample_000, 'mu16' = value_0.
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset source URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Predictions include columns 'id', 'mu16', and 'mu84'. 'id' matches the input sample identifiers, 'mu16' matches the lower bound from the input, and 'mu84' represents the predicted upper bound of the signal strength parameter µ. Example: 'id' = sample_000, 'mu16' = value_0, 'mu84' = 0.7036028427066264.

field.name: id
field.description: Sample identifier matching the input dataset. Example: sample_000.

field.name: mu16
field.description: Lower bound of the signal strength parameter µ, matching the input dataset. Example: value_0.

field.name: mu84
field.description: Predicted upper bound of the signal strength parameter µ. Example: 0.7036028427066264.

cr:evaluation.notes: Quantile Score is computed as -log((average_interval_width + epsilon) * penalty_function(c, target_coverage, sigma68)). Average Interval Width (w) is the mean width of the predicted intervals. Coverage (c) measures the proportion of true intervals covered by the predicted intervals. Penalty Function (f(c)) penalizes deviations from the target coverage of 68.27%.

fill_in_the_blank: paper_id - original paper DOI is missing from the bundle files.
cr:input[0].contentUrl - dataset source URL is missing from the bundle files.
